clips.title: The story
paras: Astranaar’s defense reaches beyond Ashenvale’s forest. Shindrell Swiftfire, a night elf sentinel and scout, watches from the town at the heart of night elf operations in Ashenvale. Alert to changing dangers along Kalimdor’s western reaches, she directs capable Alliance adventurers toward threats on the coast and nearby mountain passes, helping coordinate local defense against dangers from sea and wilds.

From Astranaar’s winding walkways, Shindrell Swiftfire watches the frontiers beyond Ashenvale. Sentinels face Horde logging incursions from the east and south, while Shindrell keeps watch beyond the woodland itself. Travelers arrive from Darkshore or set out toward Stonetalon’s jagged ridges, and she helps ensure Astranaar is not left undefended against danger from the flank.

On Ashenvale’s northwestern shore, the troubled Zoram Strand draws Shindrell’s attention. Hostile naga have emerged from the ocean depths, a grave mystery and a direct threat to Kaldorei settlements. Shindrell sends seasoned fighters to investigate the shoreline and coordinate with scouts near the coast, seeking to contain the serpentine invaders before they gain a lasting foothold on ancient night elf lands.
